target.experimental: primary Ea, meV; literature-reported apparent conductivity activation energy in oxygen-ion-conducting oxides
target.source: unchanged Cohort K primary Ea in Phase2 cohort_manifest; no HT regimes
target.DFT_population: published charge0.csv only, 1745 labels / 824 formulas; pinned hash 12f2f270127f98be9f1dc5e73619f1c995ab21b71f3a94493081d5890f37e596

features.downstream: exact frozen Phase2 composition_features.csv, all 144 columns including fixed component indicators; baseline unmodified; each auxiliary adds one scalar
features.preprocessing: median imputation (empty ->0) and training-only exact-constant filter for both tree estimators, no scaling; no global fitted preprocessing

cleaning: reuse Phase3A.2 full-483 test-group closure exclusions and allowed source lists; no recomputed outer eligibility; exact or nonO chemical system as frozen

auxiliary_policy.secondary: XGBoost real Ef_min exact P3 only

fixed.XGBoost: 150 trees; reg_lambda=10; hist; squared-error; n_jobs=2; subsample/colsample=1; no early stopping

auxiliary_policy.selection: five chemical-system GroupKFold folds, shuffle=True, seed314159; sorted formula IDs, sorted factorized chemical systems; pooled formula MAE; first candidate wins ties; refit all allowed formulas
auxiliary_policy.null_generation: per allowed population sorted formula IDs; numpy default_rng(seed).permutation(formula Ef_min) for shuffled, standard_normal(N) for random; generate once before DFT CV; same fixed vector across candidates; no experimental Ea available
auxiliary_policy.cache: identical allowed IDs, target construction, seed, estimator and grid share deterministic fit; every configuration links to its job; never cache across different allowed sets

downstream_policy.inner: three shuffled GroupKFold connected-group splits on eligible outer-training rows; seed original outer seed +100+fold; frozen before outcomes; pooled row MAE, first candidate wins ties
downstream_policy.selection: composition baseline only; finish every baseline selection before auxiliary fitting/evaluation; reuse selected hyperparameters and model seed across all matched arms
downstream_policy.inner_auxiliary_fits: none: latest user mandates baseline-only tuning, so no DFT-supervised feature enters inner validation or model selection; outer eligibility remains frozen; this differs from an augmented-arm inner-tuning design that would require inner DFT exclusions
downstream_policy.outer_fit: all arms identical eligible train/test IDs; test Ea unavailable to fitting/tuning functions; load outcomes for scoring only after predictions saved

analyses.primary: exact P3, DFT ExtraTrees -> experimental ExtraTrees: baseline, real Efmin,20shuffled,20random
analyses.system_sensitivity: system P3 same A/B/C/D, report both-repeat intersection
analyses.secondary_downstream: exact P3 downstream XGBoost same controls and Efmean
analyses.secondary_auxiliary: exact P3 real XGBoost auxiliary into downstream ExtraTrees, compare same baseline
analyses.Efmean: secondary exact P3 and exact P4, never promotes to primary
analyses.P4: Perovskite-related only confirmatory 40 rows/11groups; Apatite37original/28covered/3groups, Scheelite16covered/4groups,delta12covered/4groups exploratory; all four frozen P4 train/test/purges reused; no macro-family confirmation
analyses.Perovskite_component: same family-trained predictions stratified by bulk16rows/6groups and total24rows/7groups, not separate component model refits; two groups overlap; sensitivity only

uncertainty.unit: original global connected_group_id, common multiplicity across all arms
uncertainty.repeat_handling: average each row-arm absolute loss across its two OOF predictions before bootstrap; not loss of averaged prediction; P4 one prediction
uncertainty.estimand: row-weighted MAE; paired baseline-real, null ensemble-real, auxiliary-secondary gains
uncertainty.null_ensemble: mean absolute error across all20 seeds per row, after repeat averaging; never average predictions to obtain ensemble error
uncertainty.CI: percentile95%, conditional on fitted models/frozen source and splits; resample G groups with replacement retaining all rows; P4G<5 report point estimates without inferential CI; Perovskite componentG6/7 fragile intervals
uncertainty.additional_metrics: RMSE computed from repeat-averaged squared losses; R2 descriptive only N>=20 and target SD>=100meV; no target changes

criteria.material_positive: baseline MAE-real MAE >=25meV AND relative gain>=0.10 AND paired delta CI lower>0
criteria.material_negative: real MAE-baseline MAE>=25meV AND relative worsening>=0.10 AND paired baseline-real delta CI upper<0
criteria.defect_specific: material positive AND shuffled-mean-loss minus real CI lower>0 AND random-mean-loss minus real CI lower>0
criteria.robustness: system-clean supportive iff delta>0; secondary model direction reported; major contradictory reversal = symmetric material_negative criterion in system or downstream sensitivity, not merely negative tiny point estimate
categories_priority: NO MATERIAL TRANSFER if primary material_positive fails
NON-SPECIFIC AUXILIARY BENEFIT if primary material_positive passes but either specificity interval fails
DEFECT-SPECIFIC POSITIVE TRANSFER if primary material_positive and both specificity tests pass and neither main robustness sensitivity has major contrary reversal

NO MATERIAL TRANSFER as conservative overall fallback if primary-specific gain is materially contradicted by prespecified robustness; explicitly retain the positive primary result and explain veto; never invent fifth category
criteria.family: same materiality, one confirmatory family only; no broad cross-family claims; confirmatory family tested separately, no pooling or multiplicity-adjusted global claim
criteria.Go_interpretation: GO for further separately authorized research only if category A; category B partial nonspecific support; C null material-transfer result; D negative-transfer result; no automatic next phase

stopping_rules: run every prespecified seed/model/analysis regardless of outcome
no performance-driven retuning, threshold changes, exclusion or model substitution
stop on source hash mismatch, leakage or nonfinite predictions; fix implementation with transparent log without changing scientific plan
checkpoint completed deterministic jobs; resume failures only, no repeated success fits
